def test_basic():
    text = """# service settings

    result = read_settings(text)
    assert result['endpoint'] == 'http://127.0.0.1:11434'
    assert result['enabled'] is True

def test_enabled_false():
    text = """endpoint = http://example.com
enabled = false"""
    result = read_settings(text)
    assert result['enabled'] is False

def test_whitespace_handling():
    text = """  endpoint=http://test.com  
  enabled=true  
"""
    result = read_settings(text)
    assert result['endpoint'] == 'http://test.com'
    assert result['enabled'] is True

def test_duplicate_key_raises_error():
    text = """endpoint = http://test.com

endpoint = http://other.com"""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        read_settings(text)

noequals"""
